# PositionTexture <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PositionTexture:Void texture:Int32, u_offset:Float32, v_offset:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `texture` | In | Int32 | required | The texture to move. |
| `u_offset` | In | Float32 | required | Horizontal offset. |
| `v_offset` | In | Float32 | required | Vertical offset. |

## Description

Moves the texture coordinates by an absolute offset. The image appears to slide across the surface, which is how scrolling water or conveyor belts are done. The offset is a fraction of the texture: 1 moves it by one full repeat, which looks the same as 0. Every entity that uses the texture changes at once.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 70, 100, 160
light = CreateLight()
plane = CreateCube()
ScaleEntity plane, 2.2, 1.2, 0.05
PositionEntity plane, 0, 0, 4

tex = CreateTexture(64, 64, 1 + 4096)
SetBuffer TextureBuffer(tex)
ClsColor 30, 120, 200
Cls
Color 255, 255, 255
For i = 0 To 3
	Rect i * 16 + 4, 0, 8, 64, 1
Next
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
EntityTexture plane, tex
For i = 0 To 39
	PositionTexture tex, i / 40.0, 0
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Next
```
